title: Codex Image Grid generate_image_grid input
description: The live MCP input. Prompt count multiplied by variants per prompt must not exceed 24 total jobs.

prompts.description: Prompt Batch input. Pass project-specific visual directions.

count.description: Variants per prompt. prompts.length × count must be at most 24.

engine.description: Always set this. Image Grid does not choose an engine and rejects a call without one: use the engine the user or the calling workflow decided on, and ask the user when neither has. openai-image-api bills each image.

aspectRatio.description: Always set this for generate. Image Grid does not choose an aspect ratio and rejects a generation without one. edit preserves the source ratio and needs none.

referencePremise.description: Optional visual identity notes from the current product or reference image.

referenceImagePath.description: Optional absolute local PNG, JPEG, or WebP path to attach as the visual reference.

waitMs.description: Optional short wait for completion before returning.
